# Teaching

This repository hosts materials for modules I teach. This year is an experiment in developing new (better?) ways of learning with and about AI-assisted coding.

This experiment thus reverts previous practice of [AI use](./MN5813/2026-27/ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS.md). Given that it is becoming increasingly important to learn *how* to use AI for programming and data analytics tasks (probably an understatement by now), I have decided to make this year's module content completely [AI-open](./MN5813/2026-27/Guides/ai-guide.md).

## Licence

This repository is split-licensed, because it holds two different kinds of work:

- **Code**: The `Tools/` directory, standalone scripts, and the code cells of the notebooks are under the MIT Licence. See [`LICENSE-code`](LICENSE-code).
- **Teaching materials**: Notebook prose, the guides, the README files and the assessment documents are under [Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). See [`LICENSE-materials`](LICENSE-materials).

A notebook therefore carries both: Its code cells are MIT, its prose is CC BY-SA 4.0.

## Contributing

These materials are an experiment. The more people use, test, and refine them, the more useful they will become for everyone. So please reuse them and consider contributing improvements, submit issues, participate in discussions etc.
